summary: Soligenix, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to update an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering under a Sales Agreement with Rodman & Renshaw LLC. The prior maximum of $6.4M is replaced with a new $2.5M tranche, reflecting that $6.2M was already sold. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation, as it merely expands capacity under an existing S-3 registration. No structural event, activist, merger, or restructuring is involved. The stock trades on Nasdaq under SNGX.
